title: Multiple mailboxes
blurb: Settings → Accounts opens on Your accounts with Add account and actionable cards showing each full identity, provider and sync/sign-in status. The current mailbox’s settings appear immediately; without a current mailbox the first connected account opens. Click a card to manage that account without changing the Mail view. Signatures, Inbox Automation, Out of Office, reconnect, permissions and reviewed removal use the displayed account. Unsaved Out of Office edits require discard confirmation before switching. With no accounts, Add account starts setup. Connection & credential help and the optional computer-wide Google client remain below the account settings. Sender names and aliases stay in Compose. Connect Google, Microsoft, and IMAP mailboxes. Password reconnects save the matching login type and servers after credentials are saved; failures attempt to restore prior credentials. Inbox under All Account Mail lists downloaded Gmail All Mail, or Inbox for other accounts. Disconnect invalidates queued sync and pending reconnects; server mail stays. Start a new connection after removal to add it again. Gmail Delete moves to Trash; deleting again keeps mail there. Conversation Trash acts once per Gmail message across label copies, with one membership snapshot for Undo. Verified copies leave their old labels after Trash; unrelated cached mail and unsaved edits stay. Archive removes Inbox membership even from All Mail or a search copy. Gmail draft cleanup moves old remote copies to Trash. Microsoft and other IMAP deletion behavior is unchanged. Google login remains OAuth. New Google connections use Gmail API polling/history with gmail.modify and gmail.settings.basic; Calendar is separate. Existing Google OAuth accounts migrate after review in Accounts. Cached mail and drafts stay; uncertain actions must be resolved first. A narrower request does not revoke older broad grants; Accounts shows actual saved scopes. Gmail API cannot move mail into Sent or Drafts; use Send or Save draft. Merged Inbox uses body-free stored availability metadata, bounded per-mailbox page reads and revisioned exact counts. Snooze expiry and unread-hold still affect visibility. Equivalent refresh reads share pending work without crossing queued mutations; background polling visits at most two mailboxes concurrently. Merged Inbox Refresh still reads the local cache.
